global_invariants.statement: The application must be built with Java 17 and use Maven as the build tool.
Apache Ignite 2.18.0 must be used with Spring XML configuration for an embedded node.
The Protocol class and ProtocolParser must implement the specified wire format with a 9-byte big-endian header followed by body bytes.
All Spring and Ignite resources must be properly closed to ensure normal application exit.

integration_relationships.relationship_statement: The application uses the Spring XML configuration approach to start an embedded Apache Ignite node.
